name: SQL injection in dynamic ORDER BY clause

input.title: Search endpoint concatenates user-controlled sort column into ORDER BY
input.summary: GET /search?sort=username&dir=ASC builds ORDER BY `${sort} ${dir}` via string concatenation. dir parameter is reflected in the query unescaped.
input.root_cause: dir parameter concatenated raw into SQL without parameter binding

rationale: UNION-based SQLi via the dir parameter. Parameterized queries for WHERE exist but ORDER BY was forgotten.
